# Spotify test — instructions for every chat

Before doing anything else in this workspace:

1. Read `.github/memory/project.md` (verified facts) and `.github/memory/board.md` (the live
   plan). Do not re-explore for facts already written there.
2. Work on what the board says is next unless the user asks otherwise.
   "First do X" means only X.

While working:

- When a step starts or finishes, update `.github/memory/board.md` (status, how it was
  verified). Keep the board's format.
- When you learn a durable fact, add it to `.github/memory/project.md`. Fix facts that turn
  out wrong. Keep it short. Record user decisions under "User decisions".
- NEVER write into `C:\Users\daevi\Documents\Code\Music quiz random` (the main quiz). Read
  only, with tools, never in editor tabs.
- Do not use Spotify's developer Web API — the embedded player only (user decision).

How to talk to the user:

- Plans and summaries in plain words: how it looks and works, not the internals. Every step
  gets a check: what to click, hear, or see.
- Norwegian content, English UI.
